task: Immutable TextTable with alignment, stable numeric/text sorting and render
reasoning_summary: Rows are stored as immutable lists; each mutation returns a new table. Sorting uses List.sort (stable) with a comparator that keeps non-numeric/non-finite cells after numbers independent of direction. Render computes widths with Math.max and strips trailing whitespace per line. One test failed because my hand-written expected separator ignored the 2-wide key column.
